column1: # Mirath v2.1.0 (specification 23/09/2025), the official submission package from
# https://pqc-mirath.org/resources.html (zip; sha256 pinned in .source, checked by the
# Makefile). There is no public upstream git repository. Optimized_Implementation/
# (AVX2 + AES-NI, one directory per parameter set) with the default Rijndael-based
# commitments: the variant of spec Tables 10/12, whose cycle counts the YAML carries.
# Sizes match each set's mirath_parameters.h and data/schemes/Mirath.yaml; our build
# reproduces the shipped commit_rijndael KATs for all 12 sets.
# Columns: file, name, pk, sk, sig, iters, dir (Optimized_Implementation/mirath_tcith/<dir>),
